edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve solely the dispute concerning [DESCRIBE THE SPECIFIC TRANSACTION, EVENTS, AND CLAIMS TO BE RESOLVED] (the “Dispute”). The Dispute is the subject of [CASE CAPTION], pending in [COURT], Case No. [CASE NUMBER] (the “Action”) [OR CONFIRM THAT NO ACTION IS PENDING]. These identifying details must be completed and mutually confirmed before execution. No unrelated dispute is included.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 35,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after the later of execution of this Agreement by both parties and Defendant’s receipt of Plaintiff’s verified written payment instructions. Payment shall be made by wire transfer of immediately available funds to the account designated in those instructions. A business day means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a day on which commercial banks in New York, New York are authorized or required to close. Any unpaid balance shall accrue simple interest from the payment deadline until receipt at the lesser of six percent per annum or the maximum lawful rate. If payment is not received when due, Plaintiff may give written notice of default. If the default remains uncured five business days after Defendant receives that notice, Plaintiff may elect either to enforce the unpaid Settlement Amount and accrued interest or to terminate the settlement and pursue the underlying claims. Plaintiff may not recover twice for the same loss, and all payments received shall be credited against any recovery. In an action to enforce this Agreement, the prevailing party may recover reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs to the extent permitted by law.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt in full of the Settlement Amount and any accrued late-payment interest in immediately available funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant solely from claims arising out of the Dispute specifically identified in the Recitals, whether known or unknown, through the date of execution of this Agreement. No unrelated claims or claims to enforce this Agreement are released. Within five business days after receipt of those funds in full, Plaintiff shall file, or cooperate in filing, the documents necessary to dismiss with prejudice only the claims in the Action resolved by this Agreement, with each party bearing its own fees and costs of the underlying Action. No dismissal shall be required before full cleared payment. Any dismissal shall preserve the parties’ rights to enforce this Agreement in a court of competent jurisdiction.
